case_number: Civil Appeal No. ...... of 2022 (Arising out of SLP (C) No. 19413 of 2018)

parties.respondent: M/S JMS Steels and Power Corporation & Anr.

summary: The appeal challenged the dismissal of leave to defend in a summary suit for recovery of Rs. 89,50,244/- for steel supplied under purchase orders issued by the appellant. The Trial Court and High Court held no triable issue existed, finding joint and several liability due to agency and benefit; Supreme Court affirmed that no substantial defence was made, with payment obligations arising from conduct and contractual role.
legal_provisions_cited: Order XXXVII, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; affirmation of decree for recovery of Rs. 89,50,244/- with 10% interest and joint and several liability of defendants.
